# GitHub Copilot Repository Instructions

- Use repository quality scripts before proposing or finalizing changes.
- Keep shell, Python, PowerShell, and workflow files lint-clean and formatter-clean.
- Enforce 140-character maximum line length for all non-Markdown text files.
- Do not introduce lint suppressions or disable directives.
- Keep CI and local quality checks equivalent.
- Preserve and verify 90 percent minimum coverage.
